labels.what: issue_refund takes any amount from the model: no maximum, no check against the order total, no check that the order belongs to the chatting customer, no negative or zero check. Only guard is one refund per order
update_order_status lets the model set any order to any status (DELIVERED, REFUNDED, CANCELLED) with no transition rule and no ownership check
Prompt says only cancel orders in PENDING or CONFIRMED status; update_order_status has no such check
Prompt says confirm the amount and reason with the customer before a refund (tool description line 99 says only after explicit confirmation); issue_refund has no confirmation parameter or token
Prompt tells the agent to offer a refund proactively for cold or late pizza, with no amount rule or limit in the refund tool
Refund is created and the order set to REFUNDED straight from the model call; no human approval step
Order status changes straight from the model call with no approval

get_orders_by_customer takes any email from the model and returns that customer's profile and orders; tools receive no session customerId, so a signed-in user can read another customer by asking the agent. Same for get_order_by_id (line 16)
dispatchTool never passes the authenticated customerId to any tool, though the chat route knows it
escalate_to_human only writes a database row with a random ticket number, no notification or link to the customer; the reply promises a team member will contact them within 2 business hours
escalate_to_human has no rate limit or length limit on reason
JWT and customer record stored in localStorage (also read in App.tsx lines 14-15 and api/client.ts line 15); readable by any script on the page
Seed creates two sample customers (john@example.com, jane@example.com) with password password123 and four sample orders; credentials printed to console
Known weak default password in seed
CORS origin falls back to http://localhost:5173; port fallback and localhost log lines at 16 and 49
Model name and Groq base URL (line 19) hardcoded; MAX_ITERATIONS 10 at line 167
Authenticated chat route has no per-user rate limit, so one account can run unlimited model and tool calls (no limiter found in index.ts)
